correctness.rationale: The greedy occurrence time of each fixed subsequence has first-hit PGF I_t and successive equal/different target-symbol waiting PGFs S_t,F_t, independently by the strong Markov property. Binary palindromes are encoded by a first symbol and mirrored adjacency indicators: odd lengths give 2(S²+F²)^k, even lengths 2S(S²+F²)^k. Coefficientwise summation and division by (1-z) yield exactly 2I(1+S)/[(1-z)(1-H)]. For 0<t<1 the positive solution H(r)=1 is simple, inside the unit circle, and the z²/z³ support ensures it is the unique dominant pole. At fixed z, H=F²+[z-(1-z)F]² is convex in F and any first positive crossing of level one has positive F derivative; since F increases strictly in t, r decreases strictly, so growth base increases. At t=0 P_n=n; at t=1 the alternating chain has a second dominant pole and only growth base, not one-constant asymptotic, is claimed. Independent exhaustive binary words n<=8, three exact Markov parameters and coefficient comparison (24 cases) corroborated the rational PGF.
